question: In human beings, which of the following parts of the alimentary canal excretes waste material?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **anus** is the **opening at the end of the digestive tract,** through which solid waste leaves the body.
 
• The anus is approximately **2.5 to 4 centimeters** (about 1 to 1.5 inches) in length in adults.
 
• The primary function of the anus is to regulate the** expulsion of feces** from the body.
 
• It is the final part of the **gastrointestinal (GI) system**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **large intestine**, also known as the colon, is the final part of the digestive system, measuring about **1.5 meters (5 feet) in length.**
 
• The main functions include the **Absorption of water and electrolytes the formation and storage of feces, Bacterial fermentation of undigested food.**
 
• The **small intestine **is a long, coiled tube that is approximately **6 meters** **(20 feet) in length**, connecting the stomach to the large intestine.
 
• The primary functions include the **Digestion of food **using enzymes from the pancreas and bile from the liver and the absorption of nutrients, vitamins, and minerals into the bloodstream.
 
• The **appendix** is a small, tube-like structure attached to the **cecum of the large intestine**.
 
• It measures about **5 to 10 centimeters (2 to 4 inches)** in length.
